name: George Whitesides
stance: A leading House voice on superintelligence risk — monitoring recursive self-improvement, pausing frontier training, and catastrophic-risk red lines.

statements.text: Introduced the Self-Improving AI Monitoring Act with Rep. Harrigan, directing CAISI to monitor frontier models' autonomous AI-R&D capabilities and recursive self-improvement.
When you take humans out of the driver's seat and let machines train machines, small glitches can snowball into major security risks fast.
In a Washington Post op-ed, called for an industry-wide 30-day Safety Stand-Down on frontier AI development, backed by legislation.
The people building this technology put the odds of catastrophe somewhere between 1 in 100 and a coin flip.
